_meta.purpose: Partner decision data for the Instagram ordering activation add-on. Used by scripts/ig_ordering_workorder.py.
_meta.authority_rule: The partner list shown inside the CLIENT'S OWN Instagram app is the only authoritative list. It varies by country and changes without notice. Everything here is indicative and must be re-verified per client before it is stated to an owner.
_meta.verified_by: web research; Meta developer docs were not reachable from the build environment

profile_action_button.note: Only ONE action button shows at a time. Reservations and ordering compete for it.
profile_action_button.path: Instagram mobile app > Edit Profile > Public Business Information > Action Buttons > Order Food > choose partner > Save
profile_action_button.requires: Instagram professional (Business) account + a listed partner account

stories_food_orders_sticker.note: Separate surface. Does NOT consume the profile button slot, and followers can re-share it. This is why a client whose slot holds reservations can still sell food.
stories_food_orders_sticker.requires: same partner connection as the button

bio_link.note: Always available, no partner needed. This is where the Fina Calle menu / order link goes. Works even when every other path is blocked.

chownow.label: ChowNow
chownow.note: Flat monthly fee instead of per-order commission; launched the original Instagram ordering integration. Best recommendation when a client has no existing rail.
chownow.confidence: medium — pricing from public reporting, confirm on their current pricing page

square_online.label: Square Online
square_online.note: Square documents adding food-ordering buttons to Facebook and Instagram from Square Online. Free tier exists; card processing fees apply. Strong pick when the client already runs Square.
square_online.confidence: medium — confirm the client's Square Online plan tier

toast.label: Toast
toast.note: Wire this when the client already runs Toast POS. Pricing is per their existing contract.
toast.confidence: low — verify Toast is currently selectable in the client's app partner picker

bentobox.label: BentoBox
bentobox.note: Activated via the Meta Business Extension. Wire when the client already has BentoBox.

ubereats.label: Uber Eats
ubereats.note: Takes commission and owns the customer relationship. Wire ONLY if the client already uses it and chooses it in writing. Never present as commission-free.
ubereats.confidence: high on the commission model, indicative on the exact rate

doordash.label: DoorDash
doordash.confidence: high on the commission model, indicative on the exact rate

grubhub.label: Grubhub
grubhub.confidence: high on the commission model, indicative on the exact rate

eatstreet.label: EatStreet
eatstreet.note: Marketplace model. Verify current terms before recommending.

opentable.label: OpenTable
opentable.note: Reservations, not ordering. If this holds the button slot, do NOT displace it without the owner's explicit decision — for a sit-down room a booking is usually worth more than a takeout tap.
